decisions.rule: Per position, with the best DvP variant's relative change in RMSE against B00 in development (2017-2023), validation (2024) and the holdout (2025): PROMISING if the frozen candidate is a DvP variant and it cuts RMSE by at least the practical minimum (1%) in all three periods; NOT_USEFUL if the best DvP variant misses the minimum in all three; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise; BLOCKED if an integrity check fails (frozen hashes, coverage, projection dependency). Globally: PROMISING with the positions that are; NOT_USEFUL if every position is; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. A paired holdout interval that excludes 0 is reported as stronger evidence, not required.

holdout: not run: 2025 needs a frozen manifest (Phase 4)
